title: PhasmoMods mod manifest
description: A mod's manifest.json, beside its DLL. The loader reads it with core/mod_manifest.h; sdk/README.md says what each field means. An unknown field is logged and ignored. The loader counts limits in UTF-8 bytes and an editor counts maxLength in characters, so text beyond ASCII can pass here and be refused at load: each field's description gives the limit in bytes.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema. The loader ignores it.

id.description: <author>.<mod>: exactly one dot, each part a-z, 0-9 and '-', at most 64 bytes. It must equal the id in the DLL's PmModInfo. The author "vanilla" is reserved, and so is "phasmomods" outside the loader's install folder.

name.description: What players read, at most 64 bytes. No control characters, line separators or angle brackets.

author.description: Who made the mod, at most 64 bytes. No control characters, line separators or angle brackets. PhasmoMods is reserved for the mods in the loader's install folder.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, as Semantic Versioning means them, compared part by part as numbers. No pre-release tag and no leading zero, and the loader also needs each part to fit 32 bits.

description.description: One line for the Mods panel, at most 512 bytes. No control characters, line separators or angle brackets.

dll.description: The file name of the mod's DLL beside this file, with no folder, at most 80 bytes, and not a name Windows keeps for a device (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1 to COM9, LPT1 to LPT9).

contentPackFor.description: The mod this content pack is data for, as SMAPI's ContentPackFor: the pack has no dll and no dependencies of its own, and that mod is a required dependency.

minimumVersion.description: The oldest version of it that will do, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Without this, any version.

website.description: An http or https address of at most 256 bytes, or empty.

recordsVoice.description: true when the mod keeps other players' speech in memory during a contract. The consent notice says so, naming the mod. The player agrees before the DLL loads, so a DLL that sets PM_MOD_RECORDS_VOICE under a manifest that does not say this stays off.

developerOnly.description: true when the mod is a tool for mod authors. With the developer setting off, the launcher.ini default for everyone, the mod is not offered, listed, loaded or synced anywhere, exactly as if it were not installed; a developer sets developer=1 in launcher.ini to see it.

dependencies.description: The mods this one needs or can use; it starts after each of them that starts. No mod twice, and not the mod itself.

minimumVersion.description: The oldest version of it that will do, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Without this, any version.

required.description: true (the default): this mod stays off without it, or when it is older than minimumVersion or does not start. false: this mod uses it when it is there.

incompatibilities.description: The ids of mods this one cannot run beside: while one of them is on, this mod stays off. No mod twice, and not the mod itself.
